description: Provider record for the agentbus weather service. A proc serving the service's methods over HTTPS writes one, rkey self; brokers find providers with a relay's com.atproto.sync.listReposByCollection on this collection.

endpoint.description: HTTPS base URL. Method M is served at <endpoint>/xrpc/M.

methods.description: Methods of this service the provider implements, e.g. org.latha.agentbus.weather.current.
